build_swiglu_ffn_layer: build a SwiGLUFFN feedforward layer with configurable embedding dimensions and hidden channel size
build_swiglu_ffn_fused: build a SwiGLUFFNFused layer that rounds hidden dimensions to multiples of 8 for hardware efficiency
run_swiglu_forward_pass: run a forward pass through SwiGLUFFN with SiLU activation and optional residual connection
test_swiglu_layer_scale: test SwiGLUFFN with layer scaling initialized to a positive gamma value
review_swiglu_drop_path: review SwiGLUFFN forward pass to understand DropPath stochastic depth behavior during training
